name: Pawchive
subtitle: Official unsigned Pawchive iOS builds
description: Official KSign, ESign and AltStore-compatible source for Pawchive Client on iOS. The IPA is unsigned and must be signed with your own Apple ID or certificate.

apps.name: Pawchive
apps.subtitle: Native client for the Pawchive archive
apps.localizedDescription: Browse and search creators and posts, play audio and video, organize playlists and download media for offline use. The IPA is unsigned; sign it with your own certificate before installing.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds Proton Drive playback and folder downloads, password prompts for protected MEGA and Proton Drive links, faster post loading with attachment progress, lock badges on protected attachments, Media Session controls, browser-style navigation and player reliability fixes.
Internal rebuild release. Same features as 1.0.5 with a cleaner, tested codebase; the IPA is rebuilt from the refactored sources.

Adds MEGA, Google Drive, Dropbox and GoFile playback, provider folder imports, creator blocking, archive availability indicators and content-filter fixes. Updated build fixes over-limit posts with no real non-image media.
